ruleName: Playing from outside the teeing area
title: Penalty for playing from outside the teeing area
question: If you play your tee shot from outside the teeing area and do not fix the mistake before finishing the hole, what is the penalty in stroke play?

choices.text: There is no penalty, your shot counts.
You must replay your shot with 2 penalty strokes.
You are disqualified from the competition.
You get a two-stroke penalty but the shot still counts.

explanation: If you fail to correct a tee shot played from outside the teeing area in stroke play, you are disqualified.

juniorVersion.title: What happens if you hit your first shot from the wrong place?
juniorVersion.question: If you hit your first shot on a hole, but your ball was not in the teeing area and you forget to fix it before you finish the hole, what happens in a competition?

choices.text: Nothing happens, your shot is fine.
You have to play again and add 2 shots to your score.
You cannot play in the competition anymore.
You add 2 shots to your score but your shot still counts.

juniorVersion.explanation: If you do not fix hitting your first shot from the wrong place, you are not allowed to keep playing in the competition.

vocabulary.simpleMeaning: The special place where you start each hole. Usually between two tee markers.
A game where you try to get the best score.

juniorVersion.teachingTip: Show children where the teeing area is and how to spot the tee markers before hitting.
likelyMisconceptions: Some kids may think it's okay if you just keep playing.
Some may believe you only get a few extra shots as a penalty.
